name: Standard OPM minutes

sections.title: Safety
sections.hint: incidents, near misses, site safety concerns, toolbox talks

sections.title: Schedule
sections.hint: baseline and look-ahead schedule, milestones, delays, weather days, recovery plans

sections.title: Budget, Change Orders & Requisitions
sections.hint: PCOs, change orders, allowances, contingency, pay applications

sections.title: RFIs & Submittals
sections.hint: open RFIs, submittal log status, shop drawings, long-lead procurement

sections.title: Design & Architect Items
sections.hint: design clarifications, ASIs, bulletins, field observations by the architect

sections.title: Construction Progress
sections.hint: work completed since last meeting and work planned for the next two weeks, by trade

sections.title: Permitting & Inspections
sections.hint: building department, fire department, utility and third-party inspections

sections.title: Owner Items
sections.hint: owner decisions, furniture/fixtures/equipment, occupancy, phasing, communications with users

sections.title: Commissioning & Closeout
sections.hint: commissioning, training, O&M manuals, punch list, certificate of occupancy

sections.title: General
sections.hint: anything that does not fit above

disclaimer: These minutes represent the author's understanding of the items discussed and decisions reached. Any corrections or additions must be submitted in writing within five (5) business days of receipt; otherwise the minutes will stand as the record of the meeting.
